data_facts_with_para.paragraph: Greater Sydney's property market remains one of the most expensive in Australia, with a median house price of$1,496,985and a median unit price of$863,257. Combined, the city's median dwelling price sits at$1,210,222.
While this reflects a0.6% increasecompared to June 2025, Sydney property values have seen a56.7% increaseover the past decade.
Among the suburbs experiencing the fastest price growth in the past 12 months areSt Marys (+8.4%),Richmond - Windsor (+6.7%), andFairfield (+6.5%).

facts.fact_content: St Marys experienced an 8.4% price growth in the past 12 months.

Fairfield experienced a 6.5% price growth in the past 12 months.
